mission_04: Whisper is OpenAI's multilingual speech recognition model that uses an encoder-decoder Transformer architecture trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual and multitask supervised data. The encoder processes log-mel spectrograms through two convolutional layers with GELU activations and max pooling, followed by a stack of Transformer blocks with sinusoidal positional embeddings. The decoder is an autoregressive Transformer that generates text tokens conditioned on the encoder output through cross-attention, using causal masking to ensure each token only attends to previously generated tokens. Whisper's key innovation is its multitask training approach: the model is trained on speech recognition, speech translation, language identification, and voice activity detection simultaneously, making it highly versatile. The decoder receives special tokens indicating the task (transcribe or translate) and target language, enabling zero-shot translation. In this mission, you will implement Whisper's convolutional encoder, sinusoidal positional embeddings, multi-head attention with causal masking, the decoder step with both self-attention and cross-attention, and the autoregressive generation loop.
